Update: Primrose Street and Jackson Road are now reopened.

---

Traffic Advisory

Police are assisting Halifax Regional Fire and Emergency with a natural gas leak in 0-50 block of Primrose Street in Dartmouth.

Primrose Street, between Robert Burns Drive and Pinecrest Drive, is closed to vehicle and pedestrian traffic. Jackson Road, between Robert Burns Drive and Pinecrest Drive, is also closed to vehicle and pedestrian traffic.

Police are asking the public to remain away from the area.

Please use alternate routes to avoid delays.

Further questions should be directed to Halifax Regional Fire and Emergency.

[4:42PM] #Ejigbo #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic flow at Iyana Ejigbo, both inward and outward bound, remains clear, with no reported congestion at the NNPC junction en route Mobolaji Estate. Similarly, the return journey from Roundabout to NNPC junction is also experiencing free-flowing traffic.

However, motorists should anticipate some delays at Jakande Gate (outward bound from Roundabout). Though traffic continues to move steadily with our officers actively managing the situation.

Further along, the route from Iyana Ejigbo en route Pipeline, Cele, Egbe-Ilewe, and Oju Odo Ikotun is currently clear. In contrast, movement from Oju Odo through Ikotun Roundabout, in both directions, is slow due to commercial activities.
 Despite this, traffic is moving. 

Finally, Ikotun Roundabout through Old Garage, both inward and outward, is good, with no impediments.
Our men are on site to facilitate traffic  flow. 

#FollowLASTMA
